lessons: The ticket's Scope fence omits tests/unit/test_hostfiles.py. stale_core in chupa/hostfiles.py is covered only by integration tests, so hostfiles.py measured 16.39% against the 17% unit coverage floor. No retry can pass while the fence stays as written.

The ticket owner should add tests/unit/test_hostfiles.py to the Scope fence and to the In-scope tests. Specify fake-git unit tests for stale_core covering current, drifted and missing committed files, plus a file absent at HEAD (GitError reads as None).
Do not lower the coverage threshold, and do not pad production code to raise the percentage. The attempt rejected both as dead ends, and neither is in the ticket's scope.

The full suite needed fixture updates for the new preflight, because other repos that run serve, drain or run must be adopted and committed. Before re-confirming, check that every fixture file this forces is inside the Scope fence (criterion 4).
This is the third attempt to fail the same way on the coverage gate. Do not retry unchanged. Re-run chupa review on the amended ticket until it approves, then re-confirm.
